text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused on species distribution modeling (SDM) of rubber trees (Hevea brasiliensis) under climate change scenarios using Maxent. Although it uses spatial modeling and future climate projections (2020 and 2050), its primary objective is ecological—predicting climatic suitability for a specific cultivated species—not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction. The study does not simulate or project LULC change; rubber plantation areas are treated as a proxy for species presence, not as a land cover class within a broader LULC system. The analysis is regional (Western Ghats and Brahmaputra Valley), not national-scale across all of India. Furthermore, while the paper mentions integrating LULC data as a future improvement, it does not implement LULC prediction itself. Thus, it fails core inclusion criteria: no national-scale implementation, primary focus is not LULC prediction, and it falls under species-specific/ecological focus unrelated to LULC change analysis.)
